item.title: Mississippi elects its first African American to US Senate since Reconstruction
item.description: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith to become Mississippi’s first Black US Senator since Reconstruction. His narrow victory, confirmed on November 11 after prolonged ballot counting, marks a major political shift in the conservative state. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

item.title: France: Five men on trial for murder of anti-drug activist Amine Kessaci's brother
item.description: In France, the trial of five men accused of murdering the brother of anti-drug activist Amine Kessaci is under way. Amine Kessaci, originally known as an environmental activist, became a prominent figure in the fight against drug-related crime after losing two of his brothers to violence linked to drug trafficking. The defendants face the possibility of life imprisonment. The verdict is expected on Monday, November 16. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Angela Diffley tells us more.

item.title: Huang powers and bankrolls AI revolution: Nvidia CEO caught between 'a rock and a very hard place'
item.description: Oliver Farry is pleased to welcome Bernard Benhamou, Secretary General of France's Institute of Digital Sovereignty. Benhamou examines the intersection of traditional espionage, geopolitical rivalry and the extraordinary concentration of power within the global AI industry. Discussing allegations surrounding Nvidia's leadership, he describes the chipmaker as "the banker of the global AI system," a striking characterization that captures the company's importance not merely as a semiconductor manufacturer, but as a central actor in the economic and technological infrastructure underpinning the AI boom. "Because humans stay humans." Benhamou identifies one of the central paradoxes of the artificial intelligence revolution: even as technological systems acquire unprecedented strategic and economic importance, the individuals who control them remain susceptible to familiar forms of influence, manipulation and misjudgment.

item.title: 🔴 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to step down after affair
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair raises national security concerns
item.description: Nvidia announced on Thursday that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following revelations that he had an affair with a woman accused of spying for China. The company's chief financial officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for Huang's successor.
